articles.title: IRS Officer Ekta Vishnoi Wins Three Golds at World Masters Powerlifting in Nevada

articles.nri_angle: The New Zealand tour is a major diaspora draw, and how India manages Bumrah, Shami and Bhuvneshwar shapes the side fans will watch through the 2027 World Cup cycle.
